forward_targets.description: List of addresses or delivery instructions parsed from $HOME/.forward. May include email addresses, program pipes (e.g., '| /path/to/program'), or mailbox paths (e.g., '/path/to/mbox' or './path/to/mbox'). Backslash prefixes are removed per Courier behavior. Empty list if .forward is missing or yields no valid targets after deduplication against Delivered-To headers and self-reference. Each item is a single line string (no embedded newlines).

fallback_targets.description: Additional delivery instructions to apply if .forward does not exist or is empty (typically from .courier or DEFAULTDELIVERY). Each item is a single line string.
